verses.text: Now, brothers and sisters, we do not need to write to you about times and dates.
You know very well that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
While people are saying, "All is peaceful and safe," sudden ruin will come on them, like labour pains on a pregnant woman. And they will not escape.
But you, brothers and sisters, are not in the dark, so that day should not surprise you like a thief.
You all belong to the light and to the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.
So let us not sleep like others do. Let us stay awake and keep a clear head.
People who sleep, sleep at night, and people who get drunk, get drunk at night.
But we belong to the day, so let us keep a clear head. Let us put on faith and love to protect our chests like armour, and the hope of being saved like a helmet.
God did not choose us to suffer his anger, but to be saved through our Lord Jesus Christ.
He died for us so that, whether we are awake or asleep, we may live together with him.
So encourage each other and build each other up, just as you are doing.
Brothers and sisters, we ask you to respect those who work hard among you, who lead you in the Lord and warn you.
Respect them very highly and love them because of the work they do. Live in peace with each other.
We urge you, brothers and sisters: warn those who are lazy and disorderly, encourage those who are afraid, help the weak, and be patient with everyone.
Make sure that no one pays back wrong for wrong. Instead, always try to do what is good for each other and for everyone.
Always be joyful.
Never stop praying.
Give thanks in every situation, because this is what God wants for you in Christ Jesus.
Do not put out the Spirit's fire.
Do not look down on prophecies.
Test everything. Hold on to what is good.
Keep away from every kind of evil.
May God himself, the God of peace, make you completely holy. May your whole spirit, soul and body be kept without blame when our Lord Jesus Christ comes.
The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.
Brothers and sisters, pray for us.
Greet all the brothers and sisters with a holy kiss.
I command you by the Lord to read this letter to all the brothers and sisters.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
